description: We’re a team of science, tech, and econ undergraduate students from Indonesia taking on the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge at the Purwokerto local event. Our skills cover fullstack development, machine learning, deep learning, game development, UI/UX, cybersecurity, research, and storytelling. Our core roles are covered, but if you’re strong in visual design, illustration, motion graphics or 3D art, we’d be glad to have you join us!
